name: Run JavaScript scripts on the Process task runner
description: Runs a JavaScript script outside the GraalVM sandbox on the Process task runner, once without a connection and once with an HTTP Client connection whose parameters the script reads to call an echo API. Each task returns the runtime it ran on, so you can see where the code executed.
shortDescription: Run JavaScript scripts in a real JavaScript runtime with and without a connection.
keyFeatures: JavaScript executed by the Process task runner instead of the in-process GraalVM sandbox
Connection parameters handed to the code, with secrets masked in the captured output
Structured results returned through vars, next to stdout, stderr and the exit code
prerequisites: The Process task runner enabled with bytechef.script.runners.process.enabled=true
node installed on the ByteChef server host
HTTP Client connection to https://postman-echo.com with Bearer Token authentication
idealFor: Developers who need a real language runtime, its libraries or local tools in a workflow step, beyond what the sandboxed GraalVM runner allows.
steps: Without Connection runs the code with the task's input and returns a greeting and runtime details.
With Connection reads the echo connection's base URI and token and calls the echo API with them.
